schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT DISTINCT S.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES S JOIN PRODUCT P ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY S.PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31'
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT S.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME FROM SALES S JOIN PRODUCT P ON S.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY S.PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31'
counterexample: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, UNIT_PRICE) VALUES (1, 'Product A', 100); INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, UNIT_PRICE) VALUES (2, 'Product B', 200); INSERT INTO SALES (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (1, 1, 1, '2018-12-31', 1, 100); INSERT INTO SALES (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (1, 1, 1, '2019-04-01', 1, 100);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent. Q1 selects products whose all sales (aggregated) fall within the given date range, while Q2 selects products that have at least one sale within the given date range. Q1 ensures all sales for a product are within the range, whereas Q2 only requires at least one sale to be in that range.
counterexample_dsp: A product with sales before and after the date range will be excluded by Q1 but included by Q2.
